title: Gemini Tasks Is Now Free + 2 More New AI Tools 🤯
description:
Gemini's Tasks feature, which used to need a paid Google AI plan, is now free in six countries: the US, India, Japan, South Korea, Canada and Australia. Gemini can run jobs for you in the background, like a morning briefing from your email and calendar. Also new: Suno Visuals turns your songs into music videos, lyric videos and album art (clips up to 15 seconds, separate Visuals credits), and Instagram is testing content protection that finds copies of a creator's videos so they can block them.

Which one would you use first? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop for the newest AI tools and tech news every day.

Source: Google, Tasks in Gemini (November 17, 2026) via 9to5Google; Suno, "Introducing Visuals" (November 17, 2026); Instagram content protection via The Next Web (November 17, 2026)
